fact: On 2026-05-05 the Minister of Finance moved the Payment System Bill, 2025 for second reading in the National Assembly, to repeal and replace the Payment Systems Act, 2014 and license all payment service providers including FinTechs under one law; the House supported it, and it was not yet enacted.

The Payment Systems Act, 2014 (Act No. 11 of 2014) was published in the Government Gazette on 2014-09-12 and came into operation on publication; it frames interbank payment systems and the issuance and use of payment instruments, defined to include electronic money and electronic payments.

Lesotho's Minister of Finance presented the Payment Systems Bill, 2025 to the National Assembly on 2 May 2025, and its portfolio committee approved it with ten amendments, to repeal the earlier Payment Systems Act.
